reform_context: TAX-02: measurement design for additional corporate-tax enforcement; ABB whole-office data are context, not transfer-pricing yield evidence.

assumptions.cost_scope: Assumed additional all-in administration, data, litigation and collection cost; neither cost amount empirically verified. Includes no existing ABB cost rebooking.
assumptions.cash_definition: Actual additional tax payments after refunds and losses, compared with legislated and planned baseline; no fines, existing enforcement, advance-only displacement or social-contribution proceeds. q combines final survival and cash recovery; not measured.
assumptions.timing: Initial cost t0, annual cost and cohort receipts year-end; assessment cohort y pays at y+lag; no opening reform receivables or terminal value.

government_overlap_exclusions.note: Existing anti-fraud/exit-tax basket; not a new WERK yield.
Broad taxes and anti-fraud basket; do not treat entire amount as enforcement or sum overlapping details.
Planned third anti-fraud package; uncertainty does not make it additional WERK income.

pilot_measurement_spec.decision: Proposed staged evaluation, not adopted spending authority or a funded reform.
pilot_measurement_spec.unit: Aggregated assessment cohorts; matched cohort cash bridge must avoid counting the same tax liability twice. No individual taxpayer data in public artifacts.
pilot_measurement_spec.evaluation: Pre-specify lawful comparison of eligible case pools (phased rollout or comparable baseline), selection differences and uncertainty. Report assessed/final/cash stages separately, compare net additional cash and cost by year. Repeat evidence over multiple cohorts before recurring funding credit.
